title: Security Advisory: Your FlightSentry Version Is Out of Date
message: You are running an outdated release of FlightSentry. Please pull the latest container image (`docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`) as soon as possible to receive **critical security patches** and stability fixes.

title: Temporary Upstream Changes Affecting Unmetered Scrapers
message: Recent upstream changes may cause intermittent rate limits on **Fast-Flights**. If you experience missed checks, enable a free metered API provider such as *SerpAPI*, *SearchApi.io*, or *HasData* under **Settings → Data Sources**.

title: Backup Your SQLite Database Before Major Upgrades
message: Before upgrading across minor releases, back up your `./data/flightsentry.db` volume to preserve tracked flights and historical fare charts.

title: New Feature Spotlight: Update & Announcement Banners
message: FlightSentry now checks GitHub every 24 hours for new releases and important notices. Supports **bold**, *italic*, `inline code`, and [inline links](https://github.com/thebronway/FlightSentry). Manage sync preferences in **Settings → General**.

title: Upgrade Tip for v0.8.x Installations
message: This announcement only displays on instances running `v0.8.2` or earlier because `maxVersion` is set to `0.8.2`. Newer releases automatically hide this banner.

title: Share Feedback or Request Features for v0.9.0
message: Have an idea for upcoming releases? Open a feature request or upvote existing proposals on GitHub before this notice automatically expires.

title: Enjoying FlightSentry?
message: Check out the [Project Roadmap](https://github.com/thebronway/FlightSentry/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) to see what is planned next, or star the repository on GitHub.
